title: Especialista em cibersegurança
description:
Na Conquest One, somos mais do que uma consultoria tecnológica: somos uma equipe movida pela paixão por inovação e pelo impacto positivo que geramos nos nossos clientes e colaboradores. 28 anos de história e 15x eleita uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar em tecnologia no Brasil (GPTW). Desde 2021, também estamos presentes em Portugal!


Estamos em busca de um Especialista em Cibersegurança:


Requisitos técnicos


1. Ferramentas de Segurança

  • Sustentar e administrar ferramentas de segurança, com foco em SIEM.


2. Postura de Segurança

  • Definir e implementar padrões de segurança (baselines) alinhados às melhores práticas de mercado para workstations, servidores e bancos de dados.
  • Garantir a revisão periódica dos baselines de segurança.
  • Monitorar continuamente as configurações de segurança, identificando desvios, lacunas e oportunidades de hardening.
  • Implementar controles técnicos de segurança no ambiente.


3. Detecção e Resposta a Incidentes

  • Definir, integrar e manter fontes de logs.
  • Garantir a ingestão, qualidade e normalização dos logs no SIEM.
  • Realizar health checks dos logs integrados.
  • Desenvolver e manter casos de uso, regras de detecção e correlação.
  • Analisar e reduzir falsos positivos, ajustando regras conforme necessário.
  • Atuar como líder técnico na resposta a incidentes, conduzindo todas as etapas: identificação, contenção, erradicação, recuperação e lições aprendidas.
  • Criar, manter e evoluir playbooks de resposta a incidentes.
  • Automatizar ações de resposta sempre que possível.
  • Identificar falhas e propor melhorias em ferramentas, processos e tecnologias.
  • Desenvolver e manter base de conhecimento técnico para o time de CyberOps.
  • Gerenciar a operação de monitoramento 24x7.

title: Procurement Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).


Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.


Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.


How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

title: QA Engineer

  • Experience with Microsoft Visual Studio (.NET/C#) or Java. JavaScript and HTML as well as SQL Server experience are preferred as well.

  • Proficient English verbal communication skills

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !



Job Summary

  • We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Manager in Retail Marketing to join our dynamic team.
  • The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and leading a team of promoters and store leaders, ensuring they effectively drive brand visibility, reinforce brand awareness, and achieve sales targets for consumer electronics categories, especially Visual Displays, in retail partner stores.
  • This role requires a deep understanding of retail dynamics, consumer behavior, and the ability to collaborate across functions to deliver impactful results.



Areas of Responsibilities in this role, you will be responsible for:

  • Developing and executing strategies to enhance brand visibility and reinforce brand awareness in retail partner stores;
  • Collaborating with retail partners to optimize product placement, promotions, and in-store experiences that align with Samsung's brand identity;
  • Ensuring consistent brand representation and messaging across all retail channels.
  • Leading the planning and execution of retail marketing campaigns, including point-of-sale materials, stores activations, and events;
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams (sales, product management, creative) to ensure seamless execution of marketing plans;
  • Leading, mentoring, and managing a team of promoters and store leaders, ensuring they are well-trained and equipped to represent the brand effectively;
  • Monitoring campaign performance and adjust strategies as needed to achieve desired outcomes;
  • Monitoring and analyzing sales performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement;
  • Working closely with promoters and store leaders to ensure the achievement of sales targets for consumer electronics categories;
  • Providing actionable insights and recommendations to drive sales growth and maximize ROI.
  • Tracking and analyzing key performance metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of retail marketing activities;
  • Preparing detailed reports on team performance, campaign results, and sales achievements for senior management;
  • Providing actionable insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Overseeing the allocation and management of retail marketing budgets to ensure cost-effective solutions;
  • Monitoring expenses and ensuring alignment with financial targets and budget execution.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Soid experience in retail marketing, with a proven track record in the electronics or consumer goods industry.
  • Strong understanding of retail dynamics, consumer behavior, and market trends.
  • Excellent leadership and team management skills.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and performance measurement tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions.
  • Fluence in English is mandatory.
  • Domain in MS office package to manage big data bases in Excel and presentation creations in Power point.
  • Strong story telling creation and presentation capabilities (in Portuguese and English).

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Integrated Marketing Director to lead and scale growth engine in Brazil. This leader will own the full user growth funnel—from acquisition to retention—while building a high-performing team across User Operations, Campaign Marketing .

This role requires a strategic operator who combines data-driven decision-making, strong execution, and team leadership to drive sustainable, scalable growth in a highly competitive market.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Operations, Commercial, and Tech teams to align on growth priorities

Experimentation & Innovation

  • Build a culture of test-and-learn with rapid iteration cycles
  • Identify new growth opportunities including:
  • New channels and partnerships
  • Product-led growth initiatives
  • Local market innovations
  • Continuously benchmark against top-performing players in Brazil


Qualifications

  • Robust experience in Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing, or Product Growth
  • Proven track record of scaling user growth in high-growth tech companies
  • Experience managing large, cross-functional teams
  • Strong analytical skills with experience in SQL, data tools, and experimentation frameworks
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian market dynamics and consumer behavior

  • Auxiliar na coleta de informações para avaliações e revisões de desempenho.


Se interessou? Os requisitos para concorrer à vaga são:

A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.

A Hyundai Motor Brasil começou suas operações em 2012, introduzindo o modelo único HB20 no mercado local, projetado e desenvolvido especificamente para o país. Atualmente, a empresa atua como sede regional para a América Central e do Sul, exportando do Brasil para Uruguai, Paraguai, Colômbia e México. Com perspectivas promissoras para a região, a Hyundai Motor Brasil, também conhecida como Hyundai Motor Central & South América, está introduzindo tecnologia de ponta de modelos premiados mundialmente, como o IONIQ 5, e avançando para implementar soluções movidas a hidrogênio junto com ações sociais e ambientais para contribuir com as sociedades onde opera na região. Se você aspira fazer parte de uma equipe líder em inovação na indústria automotiva, venha se juntar a nós na Hyundai e faça parte desta jornada rumo ao sucesso.


Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade; este é o nosso DNA Hyundai; este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo. Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.


Venha crescer conosco!!!

title: Software QA Engineer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Software QA Engineer position focuses on ensuring software quality through comprehensive testing and quality assurance practices that deliver reliable products. This role involves designing test strategies, executing test cases, and collaborating with development teams to identify and resolve issues throughout the software development lifecycle while contributing to the improvement of QA processes and testing methodologies.


Key responsibilities


- Designing, developing, and executing test plans and test cases for software applications.

- Performing manual and automated testing to identify defects and ensure quality standards.

- Collaborating with developers and product teams to understand requirements and validate functionality.

- Documenting and tracking bugs, working with teams to ensure timely resolution.

- Contributing to the improvement of QA processes and testing methodologies.

- Participating in code reviews and providing feedback on testability and quality.


Requirements


- QA Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance or testing.

- Testing Methodologies: Strong knowledge of testing methodologies and QA best practices.

- Test Automation: Experience with test automation tools and frameworks.

- Tools and Systems: Familiarity with bug tracking systems and test management tools.

- SDLC Understanding: Understanding of software development lifecycle and Agile methodologies.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Mobile QA Engineer
description:
Mobile QA Engineer

Location: LATAM


Looking for a talented and motivated Quality Test Engineer to contribute to the mission of helping the world’s farmers sustainably increase productivity using digital tools, mobile software, advanced analytics and high quality assurance standards. This role is a unique opportunity to join our dynamic Brazil laboratory, responsible for testing the web & mobile apps that will operate under extreme environments and help ensure a great experience for our customers.


You will work on creating Test Plans and Test Cases and in most cases performing the manual testing based on those Test Plans and Test Cases. You will ensure our applications are accurate, robust, scalable, performant and deployable, and will have the opportunity to work with large, "big data" sets such as scientific data, machine generated data from our farmer's equipment to geospatial data, precision agriculture, remote sensing, weather and soil data. You will collaborate with product managers, engineering and business partners to enable a seamless, high-quality experience for our customers.


What You Will Do:

  • Pair up with software engineers, product owners and test engineers to deliver manual test suites to validate our web and mobile (iOS, Android) applications
  • Test our applications with different locales to guarantee a valuable global product experience to our customers, going to the field when necessary
  • Collaborate with scientists and engineers to ensure the data and software tools they use are accurate and reliable
  • Write up test strategies, test plans, design documents, and whatever else may be needed
  • Actively engage in root cause analysis reviews
  • Assist in ongoing process improvement efforts to ensure test planning, execution, and reporting is effective and efficient
  • Create detailed incident reports for production issues, and work on triage and investigation
  • Be willing to take on other responsibilities and tackle a variety of engineering and testing problems - we are a small team and all share role
  • Be willing to be a representative of the QA team on a project and lead all test activities that are needed



Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience designing and developing manual tests for web and mobile (iOS and android) with a stronger emphasis on web experience
  • Strong self-starter who will work closely and daily with an existing team of other self-starters
  • Ability to provide & received direct and regular self improvement feedback with peers
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or other related field.
  • Equivalent work experience may be accepted
  • Nice to have: Agriculture degree with QA knowledge and experience
  • Understanding the SDLC and the tester role and responsibility within it
  • You understand deadlines and the need to deliver the most valuable things first
  • English fluency
  • You will communicate with US based teams on a daily basis and bridge any communication gaps between English and non-English team members
  • at least B2 level of English, Cambridge or similar certification is a Plus
  • Understanding of common user interface design patterns and software quality assurance methodologies
  • Experience working in Agile teams, experience in SAFe is a Plus


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with blackbox testing
  • Strong experience with web
  • Medium experience with mobile and API testing
  • ISTQB certification is a Plus
  • basic programmer knowledge is a Plus


We also hinge our cultural DNA on these five values:

  • Inspire one another
  • Innovate in all we do
  • Leave a mark on the world
  • Find the possible in the impossible
  • Be direct and transparent

description:

Overview of the role


The Talent Knowledge Content Designer position focuses on being the sole owner of the Talent Acquisition knowledge ecosystem, with real autonomy to shape how hundreds of employees access and experience critical process information. This role involves transforming raw process knowledge into beautifully structured, visually compelling Confluence pages that people actually want to read. - Owning and administering the TA Confluence space, maintaining structure, page hierarchy, naming conventions, and ensuring all content is up to date, correctly formatted, and easy to navigate for all users.

- Receiving process documentation from the Process Documentation Expert and transforming it into polished, structured Confluence pages using visual aids, diagrams, workflows, and clear formatting that makes content engaging and easy to consume.

- Creating visual content including process flow diagrams, quick-reference guides, infographics, and summary decks to complement written documentation and reinforce comprehension.

- Prioritizing updates in Confluence based on usage and impact.

- Researching and proposing new tools, templates, or formats that improve knowledge accessibility and the overall visual quality of TA documentation for both new joiners and current employees.


Requirements


- Content Design Experience: 2-4 years of experience in content design, knowledge management, instructional design, or equivalent roles.

- Platform Management: 2+ years managing or publishing documentation platforms, with Confluence strongly preferred.

- Visual Content Creation: Proven experience creating visual content including diagrams, process flows, and infographics.

- Process Translation: Experience translating complex process documentation into clear, engaging content.

- Confluence Proficiency: Proficiency with Confluence including publishing, formatting, and structuring spaces and pages.

- Design Tools: Intermediate level experience with visual design tools such as Canva, Figma, or equivalent.

- Diagramming Tools: Experience with diagramming tools such as Lucidchart, draw.io, Miro, or similar.

- Google Workspace: Proficiency with Google Workspace including Docs, Slides, and Drive.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.


Additional skills preferred


- Industry Experience: Previous experience in an HR Tech, People Ops, or Learning & Development environment.

- Project Coordination: Experience coordinating cross-functional content projects or managing a content backlog.

- IA and UX Principles: Familiarity with Information Architecture (IA) or UX writing principles.

- Learning Tools: Knowledge of EdApp, NotebookLM, or similar tools.

- AI Tools: Experience with AI-powered content tools.

- Technical Skills: Basic HTML/CSS for Confluence page customization.

- Video Production: Video editing or screen recording experience with Loom, Camtasia, or similar tools.

As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

title: Coordenador(a) de Midia e Marketing Digital
description:

title: AI Pre-sales Solution Manager (Brazil)
description:
We are seeking a commercially sharp and technically hands-on Generative AI Presales Consultant to support our regional pre-sales motion across APAC and LATAM. The ideal candidate combines deep AI solution expertise with strong customer-facing skills, and is capable of independently driving POC delivery and demo development using modern AI tools.


Responsibilities:


- Discovery and Solution Design - Lead detailed discovery workshops for qualified opportunities; develop tailored solution decks, customised demos, and prototypes that address specific customer pain points across voicebot, chatbot, and agentic AI use cases.

- Demo Development via Vibe Coding - Build and iterate product demos independently using AI-assisted development (vibe coding) techniques; showcase Agent Studio and platform capabilities in a compelling, customer-ready format without dependency on engineering resources.

- POC Ownership and Delivery - Define POC scope, success criteria, and technical requirements; design solution architecture and workflow logic; coordinate with TSA, Agent Ops, and Delivery teams; oversee POC execution and present outcome with technical recommendation to the customer.

- Proposal and Bidding Support - Provide detailed solution design inputs for proposals; define architecture, sizing, and bill of materials; prepare budgetary quotes; co-develop proposals with TSA, Delivery, and Product teams to ensure technical accuracy and commercial viability.

- Stakeholder Engagement and Alignment - Engage with C-level and IT leadership to understand business objectives; manage commercial expectations throughout the pre-sales cycle; coordinate cross-functional alignment to avoid delivery risk and scope misalignment.

- Expansion and Continuous Advisory - Identify additional use cases post-implementation; provide solution optimisation recommendations based on operational insights; support renewal and expansion proposals with updated architecture and technical positioning.


Qualifications:


- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related fields

Minimum 8 years of experience in enterprise pre-sales, solutions consulting, or technical consulting roles

- Proven hands-on experience with voicebots, chatbots, and generative AI technologies including large language models, NLP, STT, and TTS

- Demonstrated ability to build working demos and prototypes independently using AI-assisted development tools

- Fluency in Portuguese and Mandarin Chinese required; English proficiency is an advantage

- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to frame solutions around cost, scalability, and business impact

- Comfortable with travel within the LATAM region to support customer engagements on-site

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
Senior Quality Analyst (Gen AI)


Garantir a qualidade em sistemas de IA Generativa é um desafio único: as respostas podem ser não-determinísticas. Sua missão será desenhar e implementar estratégias de testes que validem não apenas o código, mas a precisão, segurança e confiabilidade dos nossos sistemas agênticos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Estratégia de Testes de IA: Criar frameworks para validar saídas de LLMs, combatendo alucinações, vieses e garantindo a aderência ao contexto.
  • Automação: Desenvolver e manter scripts de automação de testes (E2E, API e Integração) utilizando ferramentas como Playwright ou Cypress.
  • Shift-left Testing: Atuar desde a fase de requisitos para garantir que a qualidade seja pensada no início do desenvolvimento.
  • Testes de Performance e Segurança: Validar a resiliência das integrações com modelos de IA e a segurança contra vulnerabilidades como prompt injection.
  • Monitoramento de Qualidade: Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade e bugs, reportando resultados para o time global.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência avançada em automação de testes e ferramentas de QA.
  • Conhecimento em Python (para scripts de teste e validação de dados).
  • Inglês Avançado: Capacidade de interagir e reportar resultados para times internacionais.
  • Desejável: Experiência anterior testando aplicações que consomem APIs de LLM (OpenAI, AWS Bedrock).
